sources.title: GitHub - KittenML/KittenTTS: Open-source State-of-the-art TTS model ...
sources.snippet: Kitten-TTS is a series of sota open-source text-to-speech models, built by KittenML. Its flagship model, Kitten-TTS 2, is a 1.7B-parameter 1-bit TTS model with in-context voice cloning and expression control. It provides SOTA quality while being so efficient that it runs realtime on CPUs and consumer GPU's!

sources.title: KittenML - Most Efficient Frontier Voice AI | Kitten-TTS 2
sources.snippet: Kitten-TTS 2 is the world's first ternary text-to-speech model: the most efficient TTS model, at $0.65 per 1M characters on Pro, and open source. 36 voices, ten languages, voice cloning, and one OpenAI-compatible API.

sources.title: KittenML/kitten-tts-2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: KittenTTS 2 runs on CPU out of the box — device is auto-detected — but the fastest way is kitten-tts-2-cpp, our llama.cpp fork. The cpp/ directory here holds what it needs: the GGUF language model and its decoders.

sources.title: KittenTTS 2: Voice Cloning at 1.7B Parameters, and the License You Need ...
sources.snippet: The original KittenTTS built a loyal following by being the opposite of everything it is now: 25-80MB models, no GPU required, Apache 2.0 license, simple API. KittenTTS 2 from Stellon Labs keeps the name but abandons almost everything else. It's a 1.7-billion-parameter speech language model with in-context voice cloning from five seconds of audio, 47 built-in voices, and expression controls ...
